visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a dimly lit bedroom, a young woman with a brown ponytail and beige dress holds a smartphone, appearing frustrated as she moves around searching for a Wi-Fi signal. Above her head, a white Wi-Fi icon with a red 'no signal' mark is digitally overlaid. (2) A sharp cut to a close-up of the phone's screen in a hand shows the Wi-Fi settings menu with no connection. (3) Back to the woman, now sitting on her bed, she attempts to play a game on her phone but her facial expression turns to anger as she looks ready to throw the device. (4) The scene transitions to a bright, studio-lit environment where the woman points upwards with an excited smile. (5) Fast cuts showcase a black TP-Link Archer GE230 router on a wooden table, featuring four antennas and a glowing pink LED strip. (6) A detailed shot shows a blue Ethernet cable being plugged into a 2.5G port on the back of the router. (7) The woman moves through different bright rooms (a bathroom, a living room with a bookshelf) while holding her phone horizontally, her face showing joy as she games smoothly. (8) A split-screen montage appears showing her working at a desk on a laptop and gaming on her phone simultaneously. (9) Finally, she holds the phone to the camera showing a 'VICTORY' screen, followed by a direct-to-camera talk at her desk where the router is prominently displayed.

The female voice shifts to a high-pitched, enthusiastic, and fast-paced professional delivery. (3) A percussive 'hit' sound effect emphasizes the visual reveal of the router. (4) A mechanical 'click' and soft sliding sound occurs as a cable is plugged into a port. (5) Several high-frequency digital UI blips and bubble sounds play during the app demonstration. The BGM remains consistently energetic. (6) A triumphant 'Victory' orchestral game effect plays briefly as the woman cheers.
